Your estimate starts at your calendar age and adds or subtracts years for each factor with enough recorded data: VO2 max, resting heart rate, sleep length, sleep regularity, daily steps and body mass index.

Each factor is compared with a reference taken from the direction of published population studies, then scaled by hand into years. Each factor is limited, and so is the total (10 years either way). Factors without enough data are left out, never filled in.

These studies describe groups of other people and show association, not cause. This is not validated as a way to estimate one person\'s age. Treat it as a way to see which habits to look at, not as a result.
Fitness age is not a separate factor: it comes from the same VO2 max, so it is never counted twice.
